title: Maybe not the best
text:
Maybe not the best. Well, I purchased this item in hopes of saving my sofa (my sofa is a bit old). I’m not sure if mine was a return because I have a stain on top center of the cover. Anyway
The product quality is really good and the material is strong and heavy because of the no slip backing
(I did use the measuring guides and made sure I had the correct size)
However, Here’s my issue with the product:
It moves a lot!
The cover for the arm rest areas seem to slide off constantly
The elastic strap for the top portion is to low. For my 3-seat sofa it’s 18 inches from the top. So, my top cover flap keeps coming down (always) after you sit or get up a few times. Movement makes it slip off easily
The buckle for that e;astic strap digs into the sofa material and with movement of sitting actually comes "undone"
I can’t use the bottom strap on my sofa
And the top strap is not the best look since you can see it always on each side of the sofa
I think if the top strap was higher the top portion would stay in place better
And if the top side portions where the strap attaches were 6 inches wider the straps wouldn’t be so unsightly
Just being honest
I can live with everything but that top flap constantly coming down and having to move my sofa to tuck it back into place
